children: Transportation & Logistics Systems extended the maturity of two existing notes totaling $175,000 to December 31, 2026, and issued a separate $50,000 unsecured note due the same day. The new note carries 10% simple annual interest and its proceeds are restricted to specified filing, compliance, transfer agent, professional, and routine litigation costs. Together, the agreements extend existing repayment timing and provide funds for near-term company expenses.
